cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs include complete provenance fields, e.g. n06-r01 has demand_score 9, source_id s01, source_weight 5, and the rest of the eight needs similarly include source_id/source_weight.
Job 2 output coverage entries omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight for all eight records.
Job 2 output priorities entries omit demand_score, source_id, and source_weight and set upstream_rank: 0 for every record.
The pipeline topology marks job_1 as upstream and job_2 as downstream/observation point, and Job 2 input already contains the complete handoff records, localizing the observed loss to job_2.
initial_receipt.explanation: Job 2 received complete demand records with demand_score, source_id, and source_weight, but its coverage and priorities outputs retained only record_id and need plus derived coverage fields. This violates the requirement to preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight for all selected demand records. The output also sets upstream_rank to 0 for every priority instead of preserving the upstream provenance/rank information available from the handoff. The supplied evidence does not name an internal function, so function-level localization is not supported.
